content: jiant provides support for cutting-edge sentence encoder models, including support for Huggingface's Transformers. Supported models include: BERT BIBREF17, RoBERTa BIBREF27, XLNet BIBREF28, XLM BIBREF29, GPT BIBREF30, GPT-2 BIBREF31, ALBERT BIBREF32 and ELMo BIBREF33. jiant also supports the from-scratch training of (bidirectional) LSTMs BIBREF34 and deep bag of words models BIBREF35, as well as syntax-aware models such as PRPN BIBREF36 and ON-LSTM BIBREF37. jiant also supports word embeddings such as GloVe BIBREF38.
